ideas.title: Following the Money in Childcare Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the financial trails of childcare fraud cases to identify potential perpetrators and determine the extent of the issue
questions: What are the most common schemes used in childcare fraud?
How much money is involved in these schemes?
ideas.insight: By following the money, we can identify potential perpetrators and determine the extent of the issue. This investigation could lead to significant recoveries and prosecutions.
